1f_v6_permutation_mechanism.v6_code_pattern: y_tr_perm = rng.permutation(y_tr); clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr_perm); preds = clf.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]; auc = roc_auc(y_te_TRUE, preds)
1f_v6_permutation_mechanism.explanation: In v6, training labels were permuted but test labels were kept UNPERMUTED. Because high-capacity multimodal neural models fitted spurious noise features, random weight initializations randomly aligned or anti-aligned with true test signals, producing a wide bimodal distribution with standard deviation 0.1975 >> sigma_0 (0.033). Symmetric permutation restores standard deviation to sigma_0.

4a_tuning_audit.bug_explanation: In v8 lines 649-670, the generator tuning loop updated variable p_c without regenerating the dataset partition. The loop evaluated the identical pre-generated dataset 3 times, emitting the exact same data hash and exact same AUC (0.8142) across all 3 rounds.

4b_cue_statistics.hard_v3_anomaly: In hard_v3, P(reddish | 0) = 0.0 and P(bluish | 1) = 0.0. In Exp B (CNN), this caused FP=0 in 6/10 seeds, yielding Precision=1.0000 and identical confusion matrices (72/0/78/150).
4b_cue_statistics.hard_v4_resolution: Generator v4 injects a non-zero cue probability (0.15) in the opposite class across text, image, and metadata features, guaranteeing non-zero FP and non-zero FN across seeds.
